summary.text: Scott Allen is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 82, based in Waukesha, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2014.
He chairs the Committee on State and Federal Relations.

paragraphs.text: Allen was born in Racine, Wisconsin, on December 18, 1965, and is married with two adult children.

He attended Kettle Moraine High School, holds a B.A. from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, and earned a Master of Public Administration and a Master of Planning from the University of Southern California in 1992.
The Legislature's page lists him as a realtor and co-owner of a printing and promotional products business who served in the U.S. Army Reserve.
It says he was elected a City of Waukesha alder from 1998 to 2001 and served on the Waukesha County Community Development Block Grant Board from 2010 to 2014.
He is a member of the Republican Party of Waukesha County and the Wisconsin Realtors Association and a former board member of the Greater Milwaukee Association of Realtors.
